caption: The drawing is rendered in monochrome, using shades of gray on an off-white background. The main object depicted is a handheld mirror with an ornate handle and a portrait of a man in relief on the back of the mirror. The handle is elaborately shaped with a groove running along its length, ending in a decorative rounded end. The mirror itself is set in a frame that has an angled, almost shield-like shape, with the portrait occupying the central area. The man's portrait features prominent facial features, with a bald head and clothing suggestive of formal attire. To the upper left of the main illustration is a simple side view diagram of the mirror's profile with a small scale in inches. In the lower right corner, there is a smaller line drawing of the same mirror, providing an additional perspective. The entire composition is neatly contained within a rectangular border, and the background is blank except for some spots of yellowish discoloration on the left edge. The artist's signature, "Karl Gurbert," appears near the bottom right.
title: Flatiron Holder
